name: Hearthwool Cloak
description: A warm traveling cloak of Hearthgoat wool — the Feywood's standard cold-weather outerwear, durable across decades of ordinary use.
narrative_effects: Maintains warmth in cold and damp conditions appropriate to extended Feywood and western-forest travel.
Recognizable at a glance to elves; its presence signals Feywood origin or long elven-contact.
